Applicant :- Nandlal
Opposite Party :- State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home Civil Secy. U.P. Lko.

Counsel for Applicant :- Ashish Kumar Dubey
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Pankaj Bhatia,J.
1.
Heard learned counsel for the applicant as well as learned A.G.A. and perused the record.

2. In terms of the FIR lodged through an application under Section 156(3) Cr.P.C., it was alleged that the informant was studying for a computer course since the year 2019 and a coaching class where the applicant used to conduct the coaching and they became friendly.
It was stated that thereafter, applicant promised to marry her and on various occasion, physical relations were formed in between them.
Allegations were leveled against the entire family member of the victim who had also promised that the marriage shall be solemnized.
Subsequently, the victim became pregnant carrying a fetus of two months, which was got aborted.

Subsequently, also relations kept to be made Nandlal vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home ... on 13 September, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/78626093/

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Bald allegation of beating by the entire family members has been leveled.
In the statement under Sections 161 & 164 Cr.P.C. similar allegations were made.
The tentative age of the victim is around 26 years.
3. Learned A.G.A. opposed the bail prayer.
4. Considering the fact that admittedly the relationship existed in between the applicant and the victim since the year 2019 and the applicant and the victim are major, prima facie
, considering the law as explained in the case of Deepak Gulati Versus of State of Haryana, AIR 2013 SC 2071, the applicant who is in custody since 29.07.2024 is enlarged on bail.

entities.text: Deepak Gulati Versus of State of Haryana, AIR 2013 SC 2071
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Accordingly, the bail application is allowed.

5. Let the applicant Nandlal be released on bail in FIR/ Case Crime No. 378 of 2024, under Sections 376, 316, 323, 504, 506 IPC, Police Station Chandaa, District Sultanpur, on his furnishing personal bonds and two reliable sureties of Rs.20,000/- each to the satisfaction of the court concerned with the following conditions:
(a) The applicant shall execute a bond to undertake to attend the hearings;
(b) The applicant shall not commit any offence similar to the offence of which he is accused or suspected of the commission; and (c) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court or to any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
